shell_commands: /bin/zsh -lc "git status --short --branch; cat .lore/test-commands.yml; cat package.json; cat specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md; sed -n '1,180p' src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts; ls src/orchestration; cat src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.beforeSession.acceptance.test.ts"

/bin/zsh -lc "cat scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs; rg -n 'specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md#|@spec|spec:' src/orchestration src/config.test.ts | head -40; cat jest.config.js; ls scripts/spec-links; cat .gitignore | tail -30"

/bin/zsh -lc "python3 - <<'PY'

s=p.read_text().replace('      if (hooks?.beforeSession) await hooks.beforeSession(session);\\n\\n      try {','      try {\\n        if (hooks?.beforeSession) await hooks.beforeSession(session);')

p=Path('scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs')
s=p.read_text().replace('    file,\\n  }));','    file,\\n    ...(assertion.fullName.match(/\\[(specs\\/["'^'"\\]]+#\\d+)\\]/)?.[1] && {\\n      spec: assertion.fullName.match(/\\[(specs\\/["'^'"\\]]+#\\d+)\\]/)[1],\\n    }),\\n  }));')

This issue changes none of them; each is a separate, out-of-scope change owned by no issue in this epic.'"','The following properties of "'`src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` record the hook behaviour and remaining limitations.'"')

/bin/zsh -lc "git add .lore/dod.md scripts/lore-list-tests.mjs specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts src/orchestration/beforeSession.error.test.ts && git commit -m 'Handle beforeSession failures in lifecycle hooks' && git push origin HEAD && git fetch origin main && git merge origin/main && git push origin HEAD && git status --short --branch"
